verdict.rationale: GitHub's mobile marketing says Copilot code review analyzes your pull requests and suggests improvements from your phone. It also says you can ask Copilot in natural language for insights into your public and private repositories, which directly matches AI-generated insights and suggestions from your own data. All of this comes from brief first-party marketing copy only; missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights are produced and what data they cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these AI features work on mobile.
